notes.title: New Year Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! 

Thank you all for this year, Thank you for playing the game and for reporting the bugs you found! 
I really hope you have enjoyed riding around on Seahorse Island! 

If you want to see the fireworks on the island be at "Östervik" at midnight (ingame time) on 2024-12-30 or 2025-01-01. Enjoy!!! 


Change Log 1.0.4

Fixed:

 Save issues on puzzles.
 Interaction issues with puzzles.
 Collision issues.
 Adventure "Apples Apples" should work better now.

Added:

 A missing loot crate.
 Fireworks.

notes.title: Small Patch version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
One week has passed since the release. Thank you so much for being on this small adventure with me, and thank you for reporting bugs that you find. I have tried to fix all that has been reported and this is the list of changes I have made.



Change Log 1.0.1

Fixed:

 Now the horse should be able to be tied up to objects like poles and trees, as intended.
 NPC can no longer tag along with the wagon. Collision is fixed.


Added:

 The horse now also checks for water when idle. Place the horse near or in water and she will find it and drink. (The horse will not drink from the sea, it's much to salt for her but she likes lakes and rivers)
 Tooltip on brush interaction.


Tweaks:

 Now the horse gets cleaner faster when using the brush or water hose.

notes.title: Problem starting the game after update Alpha 1.4
notes.notes:
If the game starts with a "Fatal error" you need to remove the save files, to let the quest system save a new file. 

C:\Users\YourUser\AppData\Local\MyFirstHorse\Saved\SaveGames

I am sorry about this, as it will remove all your progress.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Change Log Alpha 1.4


Fixed: 

 The Interact system should now be more stable.
 Wagon now has a limit in how much it can rotate (a problem in low fps).
 Wagon collision now works as intended.
 Event horse jumping now shows world markers for start and reset correctly.
 Duck Under low thinks when on horse now triggers faster.
 Horse Idle anim now does not play when horse eating.
 Can now jump over fences.


Added:

 Speed limits on the horse for swamp, water and on wooden structions.
 The horse can now look at the player when running behind and on its side. 
 Start quest


Tweaks:

 The horse now ignores the whistle when attached to the wagon. 
 Player now sitting more straight up on the horse.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Change Log Alpha 1.3


Fixed: 

 Music and sounds now fade at the start of the game.
 Camera zoom is disabled when in the menu.
 Using the menu when intro movie playing now works as intended.
 Setting the desktop resolution just runs the first time the game launches. 


Added:

 Vulkan (SM5) support for AMD cards.
 Sounds to intro movie.
 “New game” button, that deletes all files and restarts the game.


Tweaks:

 Shift now toggle between Run and Walk
 Olivia now accelerates and brakes quicker
 V-sync now disabled as default (testing AMD support)
 NPC not waving longer (temp remove) 
 NPC Names.
 NPC dialog cameras
 144 FPS button in settings instead of Unlocked FPS.
